sentences.text: Patrick Pouyanne, born June 24, 1963, is a graduate of Ecole Polytechnique and a Chief Engineer of France's Corps des Mines.

sentences.quote:
Patrick Pouyanne held various positions in the French Industry Ministry and in ministerial offices from 1989 to 1996, including Environment and Industry Technical Advisor to the Prime minister from 1993 to 1995 and Chief of Staff to the information technology and space minister from 1995 to 1996.
Patrick Pouyanne joined the company TotalEnergies (ex Total) in January 1997, with positions in Angola and Qatar in 1999.
sentences.text: He held various positions in the French Industry Ministry and ministerial offices from 1989 to 1996, including technical adviser to the Prime Minister and chief of staff to the information technology and space minister, before joining Total in January 1997, with postings in Angola and Qatar.

In January 2012 he became President, Refining & Chemicals and a member of the Executive Committee; on October 22, 2014 he was named Chief Executive Officer, and the Board appointed him Chairman as of December 19, 2015.
